article.title: 阅读二 · 全球变暖与“分析瘫痪”
article.background: 批判性公共议题评论。用吸烟史作类比，强调不确定性不能成为拖延行动的借口；语气坚定但不煽情。

sentences.zh: 还记得那些年吗？科学家一再指出吸烟会致命，怀疑者却坚持说我们还无法确定。

sentences.en: There are upsetting parallels today, as scientists in one wave after another try to awaken us to the growing threat of global warming.
sentences.zh: 今天又出现了令人不安的相似情形：一批又一批科学家试图唤醒我们，正视日益加剧的全球变暖威胁。

sentences.en: The latest was a panel from the National Academy of Sciences, enlisted by the White House, to tell us that the Earth’s atmosphere is definitely warming and that the problem is largely man-made.
sentences.zh: 最近一次，是白宫请来的美国国家科学院专家组告诉我们：地球大气确实正在变暖，而且这一问题主要由人类造成。

sentences.en: The clear message is that we should get moving to protect ourselves.
sentences.zh: 信息再明确不过：我们该行动起来保护自己了。

sentences.en: The president of the National Academy, Bruce Alberts, added this key point in the preface to the panel’s report: “Science never has all the answers.”
sentences.zh: 国家科学院院长布鲁斯·艾伯茨在报告序言中补充了一个关键观点：“科学从来不可能拥有所有答案。”

sentences.en: But science does provide us with the best available guide to the future, and it is critical that our nation and the world base important policies on the best judgments that science can provide concerning the future consequences of present actions.
sentences.zh: 但科学确实为我们提供了目前所能得到的最佳未来指南；无论美国还是整个世界，都必须依据科学对当下行为未来后果所能作出的最佳判断来制定重大政策。

segments.text: But science does provide us with the best available guide to the future, and it is critical that our nation and the world base important policies on the best judgments that science can provide concerning the future consequences of present actions.

sentences.en: Just as on smoking, voices now come from many quarters insisting that the science about global warming is incomplete, that it’s OK to keep pouring fumes into the air until we know for sure.
sentences.zh: 正如当年围绕吸烟问题一样，如今各方又有人声称全球变暖的科学证据还不完整，在彻底弄清之前继续向空气排放废气也无妨。
